sermons.description: Richard Lorenzo Jr. reveals what the greatest weapon against the enemy truly is — and why it isn't what most believers expect.

sermons.title: Why We Broke Up Pt. 1 | Unequally Yoked, Heartbreak, Making Idols Out of Each Other
sermons.description: Whether you're going through a heartbreak, questioning your relationship, or just curious to listen, grab your popcorn because we're about to get real! My incredible husband, Drew is back on the podcast today, and we're diving into the story of our breakup—a story we've never shared before. It's a powerful testament to how God can redeem even what seems impossible.

sermons.title: 5 Signs You're Under A Real Demonic Attack | Taught from Israel
sermons.description: Standing in the actual ruins of the synagogue at Capernaum, Pastor Mike Signorelli explores the moment a demonized man was exposed — not by physical confrontation but by the mere presence of Jesus, the Holy One of God. Diving into Mark 1, he unpacks the Greek concept of exousia (inherent authority) and walks through 5 signs you may be under spiritual attack: you can be religiously present but spiritually bound; something hidden reacts when Jesus' authority is preached; you know biblical truth but resist surrender; you've learned to coexist with bondage; and you resist deliverance instead of participating with the Deliverer.

sermons.title: THE KING IS HERE | A Virgin Birth or Vixen Botch? | Matthew 1:18-25 | Philip Anthony Mitchell
sermons.description: In week two of 'THE KING IS HERE,' Pastor Philip A. Mitchell recounts the conception and birth of Jesus Christ.

sermons.title: Christian Woman SHUTS DOWN New Age DECEPTION in Epic Exchange!
sermons.description: In this intense exchange, one Christian woman stands firm against 20 New Age believers in a clear clash between truth and deception. (Original source: The Dr. Daf Show.)

sermons.title: Are You Codependent? Signs, Fear, and Finding Wholeness in Christ
sermons.description: What if what you called 'love' was actually fear? In this episode of Unbroken with Eddie and Jocelyn, they talk about codependency — how it forms in toxic or familiar family dynamics, and how it shows up as rescuing, people-pleasing, needing constant reassurance, and making others the source of your peace, identity, and healing. Sharing personal moments from their own journey, they begin the conversation on recognizing codependency and why healthy boundaries are the first step toward freedom. Scripture: Proverbs 29:25, Psalm 62, Colossians 2:10, and Isaiah 26:3.

sermons.title: ACTS I & II | The True Church | Acts 2:42-47 | Philip Anthony Mitchell
sermons.description: In this piercing conclusion to the series ACTS I & II, Pastor Philip Anthony Mitchell brings a bold word from Acts 2:42-47. The Church was never about size but about faithfulness — a mixed multitude of disciples, rooted in the Word, fighting for true community (koinonia) with glad and generous hearts, meeting in temples and homes and caring enough about the lost that the Lord added to their number daily. This is the true Church that Christ died to leave with us. As time runs out: devote yourself. The King is coming.

sermons.title: TRUTH IN A WORLD FULL OF LIES | LUKE LEZON
sermons.description: Luke Lezon preaches on holding fast to truth in a world full of lies.

sermons.title: “What If You Rejected The One God Chose For You?”
sermons.description: This message explores whether God has already chosen your soulmate before you were born. What happens if you reject someone who could have been 'the one' — does God give you another chance? A look at the truth about free will, destiny, and God's plan for your life, anchored in Proverbs 16:9 and Jeremiah 29:11.

sermons.title: How I Cast Out My Own Demons
sermons.description: Mike Signorelli shares his personal story of self-deliverance. He walks through the common doorways that give the enemy access — willful sin, the occult, generational inheritance, unforgiveness, trauma, false religions, ungodly soul ties, curses, addictions, and fears — and then the steps to freedom: confess, renounce, and command the demons out.

sermons.title: When Your Expectations Are Broken | 1 Samuel 30 & Acts 4
sermons.description: If you've been in a season where everything looks burned down, this word is for you. In this prophetic message, Pastor Mike Signorelli delivers a timely word out of 1 Samuel 30 about Ziklag — the place where what you expected didn't happen, where promises feel delayed, and where loss tries to redefine your story. But it wasn't killed… it was carried away. Like David, who strengthened himself in the Lord, sought direction, and recovered all, this message challenges you to stop calling it 'delay' and step into obedience and breakthrough.

sermons.title: Jesus' Tomb Discovery! What Really Happened Inside
sermons.description: Filmed live inside the Garden Tomb in Israel, Mike Signorelli shares a once-in-a-lifetime message on the silence before resurrection. Standing where many believe Jesus was laid after the crucifixion, he reveals a truth most people miss: Easter didn't begin with celebration — it began with silence. An invitation into your 'Saturday season,' it explores where God is when everything goes quiet, why Saturday silence is where God does His deepest work, and the meaning of the stone that was rolled away. Because just because God is silent doesn't mean He is absent.

sermons.title: Prophetic Word for 2026 | This Season Will Reveal What’s Real in Your Life
sermons.description: On Prophetic Sunday, Mike Signorelli and Josh Hamstra walk through what the Bible actually teaches about modern prophecy — why Scripture tells us to test prophetic words instead of rejecting them, and how prophecy is meant to prepare the Church rather than sensationalize fear. They revisit prophetic words from a previous year with humility and accountability, then share what they're hearing from God for 2026, calling believers out of spiritual autopilot and into deeper intimacy with Jesus, discernment, and obedience.

sermons.title: HELP! My Family Is Crazy: Wise, Foolish, and Evil Relatives and What the Bible Says to Do
sermons.description: Do you ever feel guilty for saying 'no' to family? Pastor Mike Signorelli dives into the reality of family dynamics, showing that in every family there are three kinds of people: the wise, the foolish, and the harmful. Discover how to respond to each without losing your peace, how to set boundaries that honor God, and why overexplaining yourself only drains your soul. This isn't about guilt or shame — it's about walking in freedom, clarity, and love while staying rooted in God's truth.

sermons.title: 10 Items To Remove Right Now!
sermons.description: Do you have cursed items in your home? Pastor Mike Signorelli teaches which common objects can open a door to the demonic realm and should be removed now — including dream catchers, sage, Ouija boards, tarot cards, crystals, religious statues, occult books, certain toys and jewelry, and soul-tie objects.

sermons.title: Why You Feel Far From God (And How To Come Home)
sermons.description: Through personal testimony and the truth of Scripture, this message reveals how shame, rejection, and an orphan mindset can keep us from receiving the love of the Father.

sermons.title: Don't Waste Your 20s & 30s | Jonathan "JP" Pokluda | The Porch
sermons.description: Jonathan "JP" Pokluda kicks off The Porch's 20th-anniversary celebration with five things he'd tell his younger self. Scripture is clear we don't know how many days we're given — so he challenges young adults not to coast through their 20s and 30s, but to mark them with intentional, God-honoring living.

sermons.title: What The Devil Hopes You Don't Learn About Confrontation...
sermons.description: Mike Signorelli teaches on the cost and necessity of godly confrontation — why craving the approval of people over the favor of God keeps you bound, why you must be willing to be rejected, and how confrontation becomes the bridge to freedom. He challenges double-mindedness and the urge to protect your reputation instead of obeying the Holy Spirit.

sermons.description: A message on Matthew 5:27-30 — Jesus' teaching on lust, the wandering eye, and radically guarding the heart against sexual sin.

sermons.description: A message on Matthew 5:31-32 — Jesus' words on marriage, divorce, and remarriage, and God's heart for covenant faithfulness.

sermons.title: Healing the Father Wound Before It Destroys Your Family
sermons.description: A message on the father wound — how unhealed pain from your relationship with your father can damage your family, and how God brings healing and restoration.

sermons.title: Is Satan Attacking YOU With This!? Don't Fall For It.

podcasts.title: Philip Anthony Mitchell: End Times, Repentance & Awakening the Church | The Jesus People Podcast E67
podcasts.description: Philip Anthony Mitchell delivers a bold call to repentance, holiness, and spiritual awakening as the church faces the reality of the end times. From a powerful encounter with God to a deep burden for the global church, this conversation confronts compromise, challenges believers to live ready, and calls everyone back to true surrender in Christ.

podcasts.title: EP 17: Serving Without Offense: The Hidden Struggles of Leadership
podcasts.description: Leadership isn’t always celebrated. Sometimes it’s lonely, painful, and deeply misunderstood. In today’s episode, we’re having an honest conversation about the hard side of leadership, serving people when it’s not appreciated, when it hurts, and when it feels one-sided. We discuss the tension between loving people well while also protecting your heart with wisdom and healthy boundaries.' If you’ve ever felt unseen, unappreciated, or exhausted from pouring into others, this conversation is for you. We pray this episode encourages leaders to keep serving with wisdom, humility, and faithfulness, even when nobody notices. 📖 Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters. — Colossians 3:23. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more Christ-centered conversations on leadership, purpose, faith, and spiritual growth.

podcasts.title: Ep 18: Restored Together: A Story of Faith, Healing, and Love | Special Guest Episode
podcasts.description: This episode is a raw and honest conversation about transformation, faith, addiction, healing, and fighting for your relationship even in the darkest seasons. The hosts sit down with special guests to talk about what life looked like before Jesus — the mental, emotional, spiritual, and physical struggles that nearly destroyed everything. From coping mechanisms and brokenness to hopelessness and isolation, it shines light on what happens when God steps into impossible situations. God still restores. God still heals. God still transforms lives.

podcasts.title: What Starbucks Is Doing Behind the Scenes
podcasts.description: Should Christians drink Starbucks? In this episode of The Breakers Podcast, Mike Signorelli exposes the spiritual, cultural, and financial reality behind where Christians spend their money — and why your daily coffee choice may matter more than you think. More than a video about coffee, it's a conversation about spiritual warfare, Christian conviction, kingdom entrepreneurship, and why believers must think biblically about what they fund. Mike is joined by Donica and Emily of Wildhouse Coffee to discuss how kingdom businesses can take territory and why believers can stop funding Babylon and start funding the Kingdom.

podcasts.title: Former Astrologer from The Occult Comes To Christ @heavenandhealingpodcast
podcasts.description: Have you ever felt trapped in a cycle of despair? In this powerful testimony, Angela Scafidi shares her journey from the dark depths of New Age practices — astrology, mediums, yoga, anxiety, and depression — to the transformative light of Jesus Christ, and how the simple words 'Jesus save me' changed her life. A story of miraculous deliverance, hope, and finding true freedom and healing through faith in Jesus.

podcasts.title: The World's Playbook VS. God's Playbook: How to Date in 2026 Pt. 2
podcasts.description: Part 2 of a conversation contrasting the world's approach to dating with God's design — a faith-based, practical look at relationships and singleness in 2026.

podcasts.description: The Molinas share their story — how pride repeatedly hurt their relationship while they lived like a married couple without being married, and what God changed.

podcasts.title: How a 21-Day Fast Led to Marriage… Our God-Written Love Story
podcasts.description: A testimony of how a 21-day fast led to marriage — a God-written love story of seeking Him first.
